scope: Executed development checks, not complete C01-C32/AC01-AC43 certification.

checks.proves: Durable P11 call and permit, real HTTPS ARI/PJSIP through Kamailio, approved carrier UAS receives no permit header; call retry retains one durable egress route.
Concurrent consumption yields one grant; explicit ConnectionResetError after winning commit leaves one consumed permit, one route and two history states; retry grants nothing.
Real INVITE, ACK, re-INVITE, UPDATE, INFO, BYE, CANCEL/non-2xx ACK, two-edge replay fencing, target rotation and pinned dialog behavior.
Native 6.1.4 version/config validation on amd64 and arm64; missing/invalid bounds and trust fail startup.

checks.environment: Fresh uniquely named disposable PostgreSQL databases, actual non-bypass roles; round-trip after each focused authority suite.

container_security.limitation: OS-package scan is not proof that publisher source-built C components have no vulnerabilities. Image config hashes are not OCI manifest hashes.

historical_failures: Debian runtime scans: Kamailio 89 HIGH/CRITICAL findings, Asterisk 67; replaced runtime bases without vulnerability suppressions.
Wolfi Asterisk initially lacked libxml2.so.16; pinned libxml2-16 runtime package corrected the fixture.
Native config tests initially omitted the non-root writable runtime directory; adding -Y /run/nxs corrected both architecture tests.
Re-INVITE test initially accepted 100 Trying as final response; assertion corrected to require 200 and exact CSeq.
limitations: Complete bidirectional SIP, PRACK and adversarial/failure matrix not certified.
Topology protection and complete C/AC evidence remain unfinished.
